item.title: CIS celebrates heart month by promoting prevention and screenings
item.description: Cardiovascular Institute of the South is celebrating American Heart Month this February by bringing awareness to cardiovascular disease prevalence and prevention. As part of the initiative, CIS is offering free cardiovascular screenings at various locations throughout the month to aid in early detection.
